title: Sārts sounds warning on potential election disruption efforts
summary_full: Jānis Sārts, the director of the Rīga-based NATO Strategic Communications Centre of Excellence (STRATCOMCOE) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on July 31st that Latvia's upcoming parliamentary elections could face various challenges and attempts to influence and disrupt them, with threats including drone incursions, cyberattacks and the use of malicious Artificial Intelligence (AI).
